stories.title: Trouble brewing for the Patriots? Barnwell on five important Week 3 losses and their aftermath
stories.summary: The Pats got blown out. The Seahawks lost to a QB2. The Panthers couldn't overcome injuries. The Chargers and Texans fell to 0-3. What now for five of last season's playoff teams?

stories.title: Big wins for Broncos, Ravens, Jags and Steelers? Our reporters make sense of Week 3
stories.summary: Our NFL Nation reporters answer the biggest questions coming out of each Sunday game.

stories.title: Sources: Dolphins' Achane tore ACL, to miss rest of season
stories.summary: Dolphins running back De'Von Achane suffered a torn ACL during Sunday's loss to the Chiefs and will be out for the rest of the 2026 season, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

stories.title: Sources: Giants pass rusher Burns believed to have torn ACL
stories.summary: New York Giants standout pass rusher Brian Burns is believed to have sustained a torn ACL during Sunday's 12-7 win over the Tennessee Titans, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Payton: Broncos can't keep relying on comebacks
stories.summary: In their latest wild ending, the Broncos rebounded from a first-half shutout to score a 30-26 victory over the Rams.
